title: Liberty Clipper
specs: Traditional tall ship schooner with tall masts and white sails
Views of Boston Harbor and city skyline
Special requirements Children should be accompanied by an adult.

Private charters accommodate up to 125 guests
Suitable for corporate events, weddings, special occasions, and private parties

blurb: Guests sail on the Liberty Clipper, a traditionally rigged schooner, enjoying views of Boston Harbor and the city skyline. Experiences include day sails, sunset sails, private charters for corporate events, weddings, and special occasions. The crew can tailor trips for team-building, romantic ceremonies, or brunch outings.
